How do school catchments work for homes in South Surrey?

South Surrey and White Rock are served by Surrey Schools (SD36), including Semiahmoo Secondary (IB), Elgin Park Secondary, Earl Marriott Secondary, and Grandview Heights Secondary. Always confirm address-specific catchments on our
page and the SD36 School Locator.
What should buyers check when comparing strata vs. freehold homes in South Surrey?

For condos and townhomes, review two years of strata council minutes, the latest depreciation report, Form B Information Certificate, CRF balance, and bylaw restrictions (pets, rentals, age). For detached homes and lots, check City of Surrey COSMOS zoning, easements, and restrictive covenants on title.
